problems.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence - Binary Search
problems.description: Given an integer array nums, return the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence using patience sort / binary search (O(N log N)).

problems.title: Largest Divisible Subset
problems.description: Given a set of distinct positive integers nums, return the largest subset answer such that every pair (answer[i], answer[j]) of elements in this subset satisfies: answer[i] % answer[j] == 0 or answer[j] % answer[i] == 0.

problems.title: Longest String Chain
problems.description: You are given an array of words where each word consists of lowercase English letters. Return the length of the longest possible word chain with words chosen from the given list of words.

One of the longest word chains is ["x","cx","bcx"]: 3.

problems.title: Longest Bitonic Subsequence
problems.description: A basic bitonic sequence is a sequence of numbers which is first strictly increasing and then after achieving the maximum value it is strictly decreasing. Find the length of the longest bitonic subsequence of the given sequence.

visibleTestCases.explanation: Longest bitonic sequence is [1, 2, 10, 4, 2, 1] or [1, 2, 4, 5, 2, 1] of length 6.
Monotonically increasing sequence is also bitonic of length 5.
Monotonically decreasing is also bitonic of length 5.

problems.title: Number of Longest Increasing Subsequences
problems.description: Given an integer array nums, return the number of longest increasing subsequences.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The two longest increasing subsequences are [1, 3, 4, 7] and [1, 3, 5, 7]: 2.
The length of longest continuous increasing subsequence is 1, and there are 5 subsequences of length 1.

problems.title: Matrix Chain Multiplication
problems.description: Given a sequence of matrices, find the most efficient way to multiply these matrices together. The problem is not actually to perform the multiplications, but merely to decide in which order to perform the multiplications.

problems.title: Matrix Chain Multiplication - Bottom Up
problems.description: Given a sequence of matrices, find the minimum number of scalar multiplications needed to multiply the chain using bottom-up dynamic programming (tabulation).

problems.title: Minimum Cost to Cut a Stick
problems.description: Given a wooden stick of length n units. The stick is labelled from 0 to n. Given an integer array cuts where cuts[i] denotes a position you should perform a cut at. Return the minimum total cost of the cuts.

visibleTestCases.explanation: Making cuts at 3, then 1, 4, 5 gives minimal total cost 16.
Only one cut at 5: cost is 10.

problems.title: Burst Balloons
problems.description: You are given n balloons, indexed from 0 to n - 1. Each balloon is painted with a number on it represented by an array nums. You are asked to burst all the balloons. Return the maximum coins you can collect by bursting the balloons wisely.

problems.title: Boolean Evaluation
problems.description: Given an expression exp of length n consisting of characters 'T', 'F', '&', '|', '^', return the number of ways to parenthesize the expression such that it evaluates to true. Output answer modulo 1000000007.

visibleTestCases.explanation: There are 4 ways to parenthesize this expression to evaluate to True.

problems.title: Palindrome Partitioning II
problems.description: Given a string s, partition s such that every substring of the partition is a palindrome. Return the minimum cuts needed for a palindrome partitioning of s.

visibleTestCases.explanation: The palindrome partitioning ["aa","b"] could be produced using 1 cut.

problems.title: Partition Array for Maximum Sum
problems.description: Given an integer array arr, partition the array into (contiguous) subarrays of length at most k. After partitioning, each subarray has their values changed to become the maximum value of that subarray. Return the largest sum of the given array after partitioning.

problems.title: Maximum Rectangle Area with all 1's
problems.description: Given a rows x cols binary matrix filled with 0's and 1's, find the largest rectangle containing only 1's and return its area.

problems.title: Count Square Submatrices with All Ones
problems.description: Given a m * n matrix of ones and zeros, return how many square submatrices have all ones.

visibleTestCases.explanation: There are 10 squares of side 1, 4 squares of side 2, 1 square of side 3. Total = 15.
There are 6 squares of side 1, 1 of side 2. Total = 7.

problems.title: Longest Word with All Prefixes
problems.description: Ninja developed a love for strings. He is given an array of strings words. A string is called complete if all of its prefixes are also present in the array. Help Ninja find the longest complete string. If there are multiple, return the lexicographically smallest one. If none exists, return None.

visibleTestCases.input:
6
n ni nin ninj ninja ninga
visibleTestCases.explanation: "ninja" and "ninga" both have all prefixes in words, but "ninga" is lexicographically smaller.

problems.title: Number of distinct substrings in a string
problems.description: Given a string of lowercase alphabet characters, find the number of distinct non-empty substrings of the given string.

problems.title: Maximum XOR of two numbers in an array
problems.description: Given an integer array nums, return the maximum result of nums[i] XOR nums[j], where 0 <= i <= j < nums.length.

problems.title: Maximum Xor with an element from an array
problems.description: You are given an array nums consisting of non-negative integers. You are also given a queries array, where queries[i] = [xi, mi]. The answer to the ith query is the maximum bitwise XOR value of xi and any num in nums that is less than or equal to mi. If all elements in nums are larger than mi, then the answer is -1. Return an array of space-separated integers consisting of the results of the queries in the given order.

problems.title: Minimum number of bracket reversals to make an expression balanced
problems.description: Given a string S consisting of only '{' and '}', find the minimum number of bracket reversals needed to make the expression balanced. If it is impossible to make it balanced, return -1.

visibleTestCases.explanation: Reverse first '{' and fifth '}' to make it {{}}{}: 2 reversals.
Odd length string cannot be balanced: -1.

problems.title: Rabin Karp Algorithm
problems.description: Given two strings, one is a text string txt and other is a pattern string pat. Write a function that prints all occurrences of pattern in text using the Rabin-Karp algorithm. Print space-separated 0-based indices or -1 if pattern does not appear.

problems.title: Z function
problems.description: Given a string s of length n, calculate the Z-array for the string. The Z-array for a string s is an array of length n where the ith element is the length of the longest substring starting from s[i] that is also a prefix of s. By convention, Z[0] = 0.

problems.title: KMP Algorithm or LPS array
problems.description: Given a string s, compute its Longest Prefix which is also Suffix (LPS) array for the KMP algorithm and return it as space-separated integers.

problems.title: Shortest Palindrome
problems.description: You are given a string s. You can convert s to a palindrome by adding characters in front of it. Find and return the shortest palindrome you can find by performing this transformation.

problems.title: Count Palindromic Subsequences
problems.description: Given a string s of lowercase letters, find the total number of non-empty palindromic subsequences (need not be distinct) of the given string modulo 10^9 + 7.
